title: Zeroth derived augmentation respects transformations of functors
statement: Let C,D be abelian categories, C with injective resolutions [def-sp-abelian, def-sp-injective-resolutions], and A,B:C→D additive functors with a natural transformation α:A→B [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. For every M the canonical augmentations η_A:A→R⁰A and η_B:B→R⁰B satisfy η_A(M) ≫ (R⁰α)_M = α_M ≫ η_B(M). Left exactness of the functors is not assumed.

source.place: Section 0156, right derived functors computed by injective resolutions, and Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.RightDerived augmentation formulas

proof.text: Choose the canonical injective resolution P of M and let φ be the termwise map of evaluated complexes induced by α. The map P.toRightDerivedZero′ A ≫ cyclesMap φ 0 equals α_M ≫ P.toRightDerivedZero′ B: cancel iCycles in the target, use cyclesMap_i and the augmentation-to-iCycles formula, and use naturality of α at P.ι⁰.

Expand both augmentations using P.toRightDerivedZero_eq and expand R⁰α using P.rightDerived_app_eq. Cancel the inverse/hom pair of the A comparison. Commute homologyMap with homologyπ by homologyπ_naturality, apply the cycles equality from the first step, and reassociate. In nonnegative degree zero isoHomologyπ₀.hom is definitionally homologyπ, giving the desired equation.

theorem rightDerived_zero_transformation
    {A B : C ⥤ D} [A.Additive] [B.Additive] (α : A ⟶ B) (M : C) :
    A.toRightDerivedZero.app M ≫ (α.rightDerived 0).app M =
      α.app M ≫ B.toRightDerivedZero.app M
